Circuitra Wireless Charger 180 Degree – Smart, Fast & Adjustable Charging Station

Upgrade your everyday charging experience with the Circuitra Wireless Charger 180 Degree, a premium multi-device wireless charging solution designed for modern lifestyles. Engineered to deliver 15 W fast wireless charging for smartphones, 5 W charging for AirPods, and 2.5 W charging for iWatch, this all-in-one charging dock combines performance, convenience, and intelligent design.

With its 180 Degree auto rotation and adjustable viewing angle, the charger automatically aligns your device for optimal visibility—perfect for video calls, desk clocks, or bedside use. Whether you are working, relaxing, or sleeping, this wireless charger keeps your devices powered and accessible without cable clutter.

Fast & Efficient Multi-Device Wireless Charging

The Circuitra wireless charging station supports Qi-enabled fast wireless charging, delivering up to 15 W output for compatible smartphones including Android and iPhone models. Dedicated charging zones ensure safe and stable power delivery for your AirPods and iWatch simultaneously, making it an ideal choice for users who rely on multiple devices daily.

Equipped with a Type-C fast input, the charger ensures efficient power transfer and reduced charging time compared to standard inputs. Advanced chipset technology provides over-voltage protection, temperature control, and short-circuit prevention, ensuring long-term device safety.

180 Degree Auto Rotation with Touch Sensor Control

Experience hands-free convenience with the 180 Degree auto rotation feature. The built-in touch sensor allows effortless rotation and control, automatically adjusting the phone’s position for the best viewing angle. Whether used horizontally or vertically, the charger adapts to your needs without manual adjustment.

This intelligent rotation feature makes the Circuitra wireless charger ideal for video streaming, online meetings, FaceTime calls, or simply checking notifications while your phone charges wirelessly.

Built-in Digital Clock for Desk & Bedside Use

Designed for versatility, the integrated digital clock display adds functionality to your workspace or bedside table. The clear LED display ensures time visibility even in low-light conditions, making it a perfect replacement for traditional alarm clocks and charging stands.

The minimalist design blends seamlessly with home, office, and gaming setups, making it suitable for professionals, students, and tech enthusiasts alike.

Key Features of Circuitra Wireless Charger 180 Degree

  • 15 W fast wireless charging for smartphones
  • 5 W wireless charging for AirPods
  • 2.5 W wireless charging for iWatch
  • 180 Degree auto rotation with smart alignment
  • Adjustable viewing angle for portrait and landscape modes
  • Touch sensor control for easy operation
  • Type-C fast input for efficient power delivery
  • Built-in digital clock display
  • Qi-certified safe wireless charging technology
  • Sleek, space-saving, and cable-free design

Why Choose Circuitra Wireless Charging Station?

The Circuitra wireless charger is designed for users who value speed, convenience, and aesthetics. Unlike traditional charging pads, this adjustable wireless charging stand enhances usability with intelligent rotation and multi-device compatibility. It reduces desk clutter while keeping all essential devices charged in one place.

Ideal for home, office, travel, and gifting, this wireless charging dock is compatible with most Qi-enabled smartphones, wireless earbuds, and smartwatches. Whether you are searching for a fast wireless charger, a 3-in-1 charging station, or a rotating wireless charger with clock, Circuitra delivers reliable performance with a premium look.

Perfect for Modern Workspaces & Smart Homes

With its intelligent design and reliable output, the Circuitra Wireless Charger 180 Degree is a smart addition to any modern workspace or bedside setup. Enjoy effortless charging, improved productivity, and a cleaner environment—all powered by advanced wireless charging technology.
